notes: Cross-verse head split on bāḥûr. The unit at 51.22 heads *the young man* on *young* by rule 31's subtraction, and the whole family of substantival adjectives with a supplied generic noun heads the same way throughout the chapter (mighty men, wise men, the old man, young lions, the Holy One). Only 51.3 heads *young men* on *men*, and *men* alone is any men — ʾîš, ʾādām and ʿam are all rendered *men* elsewhere in this chapter — while *young* is what carries the lexeme. The head moves from t029 to t028; the unit's edges, and every other unit in the verse, are unchanged.
